title: Kitty Punk 2077 — character correction and voice audition prompts
status: Working production draft. Trixie / CatGirl is female19 with selected Emma; the four boys remain15–19. Eight pilot role voices are selected; final performances and unfinished visual deliverables remain for review.
usage: Attach exactly the reference files listed for the character, in order, then paste the desired fully assembled prompt. No local files are uploaded by this JSON.

Generate identity_master first. Compare it side-by-side with the sources. Once accepted, attach that accepted master as the first image for subsequent views and keep source references as secondary identity checks. Adjust Image numbering accordingly.
Run each view prompt independently; seven deliverables per character. Do not ask for all21 characters in one generation.
Store accepted outputs with version numbers; rejected variants never replace the source masters.
For existing characters, identity fidelity is required. For proposed characters, the first accepted master establishes the new design.
Paw/human hand and AI-interface variants are deliberately species-specific.

Current selected voices: Trixie/Emma, Byte/Northern Terry, Ghost/Austin—Upbeat, Neon/Ryan, Onyx/Harry, NIP7/Daniel, Barkington/Brian, WOOF7/Eric. Final take approval is separate; historical receipts stay unchanged.
global_visual_qa: Correct named character and species; no extra cast members.
Fixed coat/spot/stripe map, face silhouette, eyewear, outfit, gear and accent colour.
Dr Muzzle always a Husky with illuminated muzzle and visible eyes, no glasses.
Ghost green hood/visor; Neon blue visor and scarf; never exchange them.
Five crew cats; eight named council dogs.
Animal paws anatomically consistent. Barkington never has bare human hands.
Clean image, correct view, full feet/tail, no labels/frames embedded into scene references.
